comment: The implementations of the template language and the shared units that each holds, checked by make parity-declarations-check and make parity-check of kit (T24.7). The API units are the operations and types that the specification defines as public API (T22.6-14, T22.6-18), read by the symbol extractor of each implementation; every other public symbol is a nativeOnly entry with the spec anchor of its reason. The conformance cases of tests/cases, their tokens and format results and the expression vectors of tests/fixtures/expr/cases.json are the shared suites; the editor packages, the compiler and the repository tools are single-language tools; every other test file of an implementation is the native test of a feature unit (T24.8, T24.11).
